# Swagger Request Body Guide

## 📋 Important Clarification: Which Fields to Include in Request Body

### **Rule of Thumb:**
- **✅ INCLUDE** fields that you provide (username, password, origin, destination, etc.)
- **❌ DO NOT INCLUDE** auto-generated fields (id, created_at, admin_id, status, order_date, etc.)

---

## 1️⃣ AUTO-GENERATED FIELDS (Never set these in request body)

| Field | Auto-generated by | Example |
|-------|------------------|---------|
| `id` | Database (SERIAL PRIMARY KEY) | `1, 2, 3...` |
| `created_at` | Database (DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) | `2026-04-18T10:00:00Z` |
| `admin_id` | Backend (extracted from JWT token) | From logged-in user |
| `status` | Backend (default initial value) | `pending`, `assigned`, etc. |
| `order_date` | Backend (set to NOW at creation) | Current timestamp |

**Why?** These are immutable fields managed by the system, not by users.

---

## 2️⃣ Example Request Bodies (Copy-Paste Ready)

### POST /admin/setup (Create First Super Admin)
```json
{
  "username": "superadmin",
  "password": "admin123456",
  "full_name": "System Administrator"
}
```

**Notes:**
- `full_name` is optional (defaults to username if omitted)
- Password must be at least 6 characters
- This is one-time endpoint - only works if no admin exists yet

---

### POST /admin/users (Create Admin User)
```json
{
  "username": "john.sales",
  "password": "password123456",
  "full_name": "John Sales Manager",
  "role": "admin_sales",
  "is_active": true
}
```

**Notes:**
- Valid roles: `super_admin`, `admin_sales`, `admin_ops`
- `is_active` defaults to `true` if omitted
- `full_name` is optional (defaults to username if omitted)
- `admin_id` and `created_at` are auto-set - DO NOT include them

---

### POST /admin/orders (Create Order)
```json
{
  "order_number": "ORD-2026-0001",
  "customer_id": 1,
  "origin": "Jakarta",
  "destination": "Surabaya",
  "total_containers": 5
}
```

**Notes:**
- `admin_id`: Auto-set from logged-in user's JWT token
- `status`: Auto-set to `pending`
- `order_date`: Auto-set to current timestamp
- `created_at`: Auto-set by database
- `id`: Auto-generated by database

---

### POST /admin/trucks (Create Truck)
```json
{
  "plate_number": "B-1234-XYZ",
  "truck_type": "Fuso Box",
  "status": "available",
  "is_active": true
}
```

**Notes:**
- `status` options: `available`, `in_use`, `maintenance`
- `is_active` defaults to `true` if omitted
- `id` and `created_at` auto-generated

---

### PATCH /admin/trucks/{id} (Update Truck - Partial)
```json
{
  "status": "maintenance"
}
```

OR

```json
{
  "plate_number": "B-5678-ABC",
  "truck_type": "Fuso Double"
}
```

**Notes:**
- Can update any combination of fields
- All fields are optional (only include what you want to change)
- Cannot modify `id` or `created_at`

---

### POST /admin/trips (Create Trip)
```json
{
  "order_id": 1,
  "truck_id": 1,
  "driver_id": 1,
  "trip_number": "TRIP-2026-001"
}
```

**Notes:**
- `status`: Auto-set to `assigned`
- `container_number`, `seal_number`: Set later when trip starts (via PATCH /admin/trips/{id}/start)
- `start_time`, `end_time`: Set by system as trip progresses
- `created_at`: Auto-set by database

---

### PATCH /admin/trips/{id}/start (Start Trip)
```json
{
  "container_number": "CONT-123456",
  "seal_number": "SEAL-789012"
}
```

**Notes:**
- Automatically changes trip status from `assigned` to `in_transit`
- `start_time` auto-set to current time

---

### PATCH /admin/profile (Update Own Profile)
```json
{
  "full_name": "Bambang Suryanto",
  "password": "newpassword123456"
}
```

**Notes:**
- Can update either field or both (at least one required)
- Password must be at least 6 characters if provided
- Cannot change username or role
- Cannot modify `id` or `created_at`

---

## 3️⃣ Response Bodies (What You Get Back)

### Response includes ALL fields (including auto-generated)

**POST /admin/users Response:**
```json
{
  "message": "User berhasil dibuat",
  "data": {
    "id": 2,
    "username": "john.sales",
    "full_name": "John Sales Manager",
    "role": "admin_sales",
    "is_active": true,
    "created_at": "2026-04-18T10:05:00Z"
  }
}
```

**Why?** Response includes `id` and `created_at` so you know:
- What ID was assigned to the new record
- When it was created

---

## 4️⃣ Immutable Fields Explanation

### In Swagger UI:
- **Request Body** (`Try-it-out`): Only shows user-editable fields with examples
- **Response Body** (`200` response): Shows ALL fields including immutable ones

### What each immutable field means:

| Field | What It Means | Can You Change? |
|-------|---------------|-----------------|
| `id` | Unique identifier, primary key | ❌ NO - Auto-assigned |
| `created_at` | When record was created | ❌ NO - System timestamp |
| `admin_id` | Which admin created this | ❌ NO - From JWT |
| `status` | Current state (pending, in_transit, etc) | ⚠️ ONLY via specific endpoints (e.g., PATCH /admin/orders/{id} to change status) |

---

## 5️⃣ Best Practice Checklist

Before sending a POST/PATCH request:

- [ ] Included all **required** fields
- [ ] Used **example values** provided in Swagger as reference
- [ ] **Did NOT include** `id`, `created_at`, `admin_id`, `status` (unless endpoint specifically accepts them)
- [ ] Verified **password** is at least 6 characters
- [ ] Verified **role** is one of: `super_admin`, `admin_sales`, `admin_ops`
- [ ] Have valid **JWT token** in `Authorization: Bearer` header for admin endpoints

---

## 6️⃣ Updated Endpoint Organization

### Endpoints Grouped by Feature (in Swagger UI)

**1. AUTHENTICATION** (2 endpoints - public)
- `POST /auth/login` - Get JWT token
- `POST /auth/logout` - Logout

**2. USER MANAGEMENT** (4 endpoints)
- `POST /admin/setup` - **MOVED HERE** - Initialize first admin
- `POST /admin/users` - Create new admin
- `PATCH /admin/profile` - Update own profile
- `GET /admin/dashboard/stats` - View dashboard

**3-7. Other endpoints** (Trucks, Orders, Trips, Locations, Public Tracking)

---

## 📖 Summary

✅ **Request body**: Only user-provided fields (with Swagger examples)  
✅ **Response body**: All fields including auto-generated ones  
✅ **Auto-generated fields**: `id`, `created_at`, `admin_id`, `status` (system-managed)  
✅ **Best practice**: Use Swagger `Try-it-out` with provided examples - just copy-paste!
